notes: Reference date 2018-03-13. All five sources are Wayback captures of the Operations Manual dated 2018-03-21; III-22 carries amendments through 7/1/17, III-10.1 through 4/13, III-21 through 10/14, so each is taken as in force on the reference date.

III-22.8 states the parental provisions separately for 'Twelve-month faculty, professional and scientific staff, and non-organized merit system staff' and for 'Nine-month faculty'. Nine-month (academic-year) faculty are the main-campus tenure-stream population: c1 and c2. The twelve-month restatements are recorded by name (c3, c4) and not counted (schema 2b).

No paid parental leave funded by the University: the birth mother's leave (c1) and adoption leave (c2) are paid only from her own accrued sick leave (R1, R1b, R1d); the purpose clause speaks of pay 'to the extent permitted by state law'.

Not components: departments 'are encouraged to arrange for additional leave' for twelve-month adoptive parents and 'should work with' parents adopting through an agency (no grant, no length; recorded in c2/c4 notes); funeral leave, pall-bearer leave, voting time, religious holy days, bone marrow and organ donation leave, severe-weather arrangements and sick-leave conversion to vacation (not usable for a birth).

FMLA: the University applies FMLA on a calendar-year basis; 'Holidays are charged to FMLA leave if the employee is taking a continuous leave of a full workweek.' Reduced or intermittent FMLA leave after a birth is part of c5, not a separate part-time option.

Birth parent chain: pregnancy-related disability leave c1 (6 weeks, own sick leave; FMLA c5 alongside from the start, 12 workweeks) -> leave without pay or vacation beyond the disability period (c14, general purpose, discretionary). Sick leave c9 runs with c1; vacation c10 after sick leave is exhausted.

Non-birth parent chain: FMLA c5 (12 workweeks, unpaid unless own balances are used); family caregiving leave c11 (40 hours of own sick leave, up to 80 with carryover) to care for the birth parent; no institutional parental leave for a non-birth parent after a birth.

Cross-references not saved: III-24 Flexible Scheduling; III-18.3 Long Term Disability program (III-18 Insurance); III-33/III-34 Accidents; https://hr.uiowa.edu/policies/clarification-family-caregiving-leave; https://hr.uiowa.edu/fsds; https://hr.uiowa.edu/benefits/catastrophic-leave; III-23.2c (merit staff); III-15.2; DOL FMLA poster.

Calendar: the documents name semesters ('before a semester or a summer session begins') but state no length; calendar.kind = semester, and the term length follows R8's order. No component uses term units.
